==About me==

I've been a fan of ''The Wheel of Time'' since 1993. It took so long for me to get all the way through ''Towers of Midnight'', that I found I had forgotten too much of the story. So in 2011, I began re-reading the entire series from start to finish, and I just finished ''A Memory of Light'' during the summer of 2013. I've now also gotten my teenaged son hooked on the series.
